title: Daily activity and visual discrimination reflects the eye organization of weaver ant Oecophylla smaragdina (Insecta: Hymenoptera: Formicidae)
why: Oecophylla smaragdina: sweep-26 opened this preprint and records that it gives the interommatidial angle of the weaver ant's compound eye in its Figure 4E only (its text gives 710 to 790 facets and lens diameters of 13 to 18 µm), so a reader of the figure could log interommatidial_deg for the species. Ogawa et al. 2023 (10.1007/s00359-023-01629-7), which main read in full (oa-5), states no interommatidial angle in its text. Returned by the harvest queries "Oecophylla vision", "Oecophylla eye" and "Oecophylla visual acuity" and by both web searches for visual acuity; not opened in this unit.
